short_description: Keep users informed about what's happening through timely, appropriate feedback.

positive.definition: Long-running operation (>500ms) shows progress indicator (spinner, progress bar, or skeleton)
positive.evidence_required: name the action and the indicator (selector or screenshot region)

positive.definition: Destructive or important action shows confirmation toast or banner after completion
positive.evidence_required: name the action and the confirmation surface

positive.definition: Async save shows saving / saved / error state inline
positive.evidence_required: name the field or form and the status surface

positive.definition: Initial render uses skeleton or placeholder content, not a blank screen
positive.evidence_required: name the page region and the skeleton element

positive.definition: Current page or section is clearly highlighted in navigation
positive.evidence_required: name the nav and the active styling

positive.definition: Form fields validate inline as the user types (not only on submit)
positive.evidence_required: name the field and the validation behavior

positive.definition: Multi-step flow shows step N of M with completed steps marked
positive.evidence_required: name the flow and the step indicator

negative.definition: Action (button click, form submit, delete) completes with no visible response
negative.evidence_required: name the action and what was observed (or not observed)

negative.definition: Loading state is a blank screen or empty container with no indicator
negative.evidence_required: name the page region and what showed during load

negative.definition: UI shows stale data after action and requires manual refresh
negative.evidence_required: name the action and the stale element

negative.definition: Spinner appears with no label or context for what is loading
negative.evidence_required: name the location of the spinner

negative.definition: User cannot tell what page or section they are on (no breadcrumbs, no active state)
negative.evidence_required: name the navigation and what is missing

negative.definition: Form errors only surface on submit, not during typing
negative.evidence_required: name the form and the validation timing

critical_negative.definition: Error condition produces zero feedback (silent failure)
critical_negative.evidence_required: name the failing action and the browser console state
